reddit.title: New Materials Display for Building Tiles
reddit.body: We've made a significant update to how you manage resources in Provincia! Instead of hiding costs behind a single chip, each build tile now displays a detailed Materials sheet. This allows you to see exactly what you need, including stored vs. required materials, with any shortages clearly highlighted. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Introducing the New Materials Management System
steam.body: We're thrilled to share that building tiles in Provincia now feature a comprehensive Materials display. This update allows you to view all required resources at once, with stored amounts and shortages clearly indicated. No more confusion with hidden costs! Dive into the details of this update here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
